scope: Read-only native source/typed DB/renderer audit and diagnostic scalar/composition calculations, with this exclusive report the only new write.
source_purpose: Painted clouds, independently authored vertical alpha fade in a transparent main-menu mesh. RGB is source stored contribution; alpha separately attenuates existing destination.
source_private_visual_review: Whole dark blue/brown cloud RGB silhouette and palette.
Whole alpha shows broad vertical fade rather than individual cloud contours.

renderer_chain.proof: Materialtransparent typed; Format8888 is notDXT and selects primary4801.
Alpha transparent maps MA_TRANSPARENT with original reflection coefficients0.
Creates CTransparentMaterial and exposes file texture unchanged.
CF_A8R8G8B8 loads raw8888 rows directly into locked GPU texture, no color/alpha multiplication.
Transparent mesh RealRender selects COMBINE_SMART_ALPHA; no-reflection object chooses SEffTexture or fogged variant.
Plain/TnL paths use TextureCopyAlpha; fog uses FoggedParticle and retains independent input RGBA.
TextureCopyAlpha is mov r0,t0: sourceRGB consumed directly, no RGB*A.
SMART_ALPHA=sourceONE + destinationINVSRCALPHA, so outputRGB=storedRGB + destRGB*(1-A), not conventional SRCALPHA nor pure ONE/ONE additive.

decision.reason: Actual original8888 authored RGB is uploaded unchanged and used directly by smart-alpha blend, while full alpha controls destination attenuation. Extra multiplication of existing source-like stored RGB changes native source contribution and requires distortive gain5.125. RGB>A alone is not the proof; typed source loader/shader/blend chain and independent cloud/fade source content are.
requirements: Retain complete actual4801 source alpha LANCZOS4x, TypeTransparent, materialtransparent, blend coefficients and cloud layout.
Preserve all source-like stored RGB, including low/zeroA contribution; no alpha-derived visibility clearing/padding.
Use same actual builtin raw if visually faithful; numerical encoding/scalar correction can be reviewed separately with immutable versioned forecast, no imagegen replay for brightness.
Do not overwrite existing v1raw/call/forecasts/numeric, and do not claim premultipliedv1 now passed.
Inspect separate source-stored calibrated fullRGB+A against source, final built native aliases/allmips and actualmenu HD off/on/restored before acceptance.

limitations: No source-stored calibrated forecast produced or approved by this report.
No actual Game run or camera visibility claimed.
Nominal source-stored does not assert original RGB is mathematically straight-alpha, unpremultiplied or pure additive; it preserves authored stored values.
